paragraphs.text: Tech Monolith began as LLM technology in Oncology. The main idea of the LLM chatbot is related to my experience and that I met the toughness of supervised Bi-LSTM methods. Below you can see the application images of the alpha releases of chatbot.

On the application side, I decided to move with the MERN stack to follow the up-to-date community. On the AI prediction and ETL side, I decided to form the backend with FastAPI. I used models of LLM from Ollama2, and I decided to use GCP for the cloud platform. The project also had Google Cloud OCR and Cloud Storage. WhatsApp API was used from the meta platform.

I built the application and WhatsApp-integrated chatbot solution with my coworkers in two months. After that, I did some financial investigations we needed to continue. At first, we decided to proceed with the government programs and to apply the program called "1812 call code: BIGG.

We prepared the application papers for this program in the following three months. Records covered the market opportunities, customer definitions, regulations, financial forecasts, quarter plans, products and applied technologies definitions.
Also, during these three months, we sought angel investors, but the stock options offered did not meet our plans, so we decided to move on to the BIGG program.
For now project moved to silent development.

phases.title: Phase Three: New Project and Tech Monolith Corp.

paragraphs.text: At the end of May, our former team leader Sina brought us a new project on physiotherapy monitoring systems. We had 8 or 10 meetings on this topic and decided to continue with this project.

In July, we decided to run this project at the corporate level in Tech Monolith. With my leadership and the partnership of my friends, Tech Monolith was established and has been managing the project as a legal entity since July 2024.

phases.title: Phase Four: Home Based Exercise Monitoring Device

paragraphs.text: According to the latest research, people after Covid-19 preferred home-based exercise systems. This is our key point, and with this research, I started how to cover monitoring systems. First of all, with our consultants for the project, we managed a pre-version device. With this device, I decided which sensors should measure the required exercises precisely.

A device is built with pressure, tension and motion sensors. Sensors were measured with our developed controller card that is ESP/STM based and communicated with our built mobile app that is based on the MERN stack.

With the result of the alfa phase, I decided to use NRF modules, in the beta phase release. Also, new designs of devices will be applied, and a new communication system will be applied for the beta releases.
